Baraka POS Version 1.1.5

What's New in v1.1.5:
- Phase 2 Inventory Management & Reporting Expansion
- Barcode label design & high-precision vector printing (Code 128, EAN-13, custom sizes)
- Advanced stock operations, inventory ledger with historical cost tracking, and stock-taking reconciliation
- Bulk inventory import and export (.xlsx, .csv) with staged validation
- Comprehensive inventory valuation, slow/dead stock analysis, and multi-worksheet Excel reporting
- Full backward compatibility and zero customer data loss.
